points.description: True random number generator (TRNG): uses an unpredictable physical process/source (e.g. physical phenomenon) to produce numbers; results are truly random and unpredictable / not reproducible.
points.partial_credit: Half if only says 'truly random' or 'physical' without the other idea, or the description is vague.

points.description: Pseudorandom number generator (PRNG): uses a mathematical algorithm/formula (computer-based, deterministic) to generate a sequence of numbers; the sequence can be reproduced (e.g. from the same seed).
points.partial_credit: Half if only says 'computer generated' or 'algorithm' without the formula/sequence or reproducibility idea, or has a minor error.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) need both generators described correctly: TRNG from a physical, unpredictable source; PRNG from a mathematical algorithm, reproducible. Give part marks for vague or half-stated ideas on a side. Give no marks for a side that is wrong or swapped; each side is marked separately.
